parsed.internal_thinking: After analyzing the board, node 43 stands out as a massive production powerhouse with 13 pips on Wheat (9, 6, 9). Gemma and Claude are already bickering over the Brick/Wood area, so positioning myself in the Wheat/Ore cluster in the south/center seems like a solid, independent move.
